_about: Sage settings. Keys starting with _ are comments. Times are local to `timezone`. Setup (sage.py init) fills in the identity block; everything else has a sensible default you can tune.
_identity: Filled in by setup. calendar_id is usually your email. slack_user_id looks like U0123ABC. jira_* come from the Atlassian connector; leave blank to skip Jira.
_hours: Sage only places blocks inside these hours.
_lookback: Sources are read back to the last run, except a deep sweep (first run after deep_sweep_every_days, or 'sage, deep sweep') which reads deep_lookback_days back to catch older asks.
_gaps: lead = don't place anything starting in the next N min. buffer = breather after each meeting. min_block = smallest gap worth using.
_quick_hits: Tasks this short get batched together instead of getting their own block.
_caps: Leaves slack in the day: Sage never books more than this much of your free time. Must-dos (score >= cap_override_score) may go cap_override_minutes over.
_priority: Score = task priority points + account tier points (tiers live in accounts.md) + deadline pressure. Highest score gets the earliest slot.
_sharing: visibility: default = follows your calendar's sharing, so colleagues see the focus block and its details; private = they only see busy. Tasks flagged private (hiring, people matters) and the banner always stay private.
_busy: urgent = only P1 blocks due within ~a day show as Busy (so colleagues and Chili Piper still see you as bookable). all / none also work.
_look: colour 2 = Sage, 8 = Graphite. Greying a block (done_by_colour) or sending its 'Mark done' mail (mail_ticks) marks it done. reminder_minutes null = no popup.
_done_url: Optional: paste your Apps Script web app URL (tick-webapp/SETUP.md) to make ✓ Mark done one click. Empty = a mailto link you send yourself.
